lines: Na tha kuchh to Khuda tha, kuchh na hota to Khuda hota
couplets.en: When there was nothing, there was God, and had nothing ever been, God would still be.

lines: Duboya mujh ko hone ne, na hota main to kya hota
couplets.en: Being itself has drowned me, and what if I had never been?

lines: Hua jab gham se yun be-his, to gham kya sar ke katne ka
couplets.en: Grief had numbed me so, what sorrow could losing my head bring?

lines: Na hota gar juda tan se, to zaanu par dhara hota
couplets.en: Had my head stayed on my shoulders, it would have rested on my knee.

lines: Hui muddat ki Ghalib mar gaya, par yaad aata hai
couplets.en: Ghalib died long ago, yet he still comes to mind.

lines: Woh har ik baat par kehna, ki yun hota to kya hota
couplets.en: At every turn he would ask, what if it had been this way?
